Global Corporate Security & Risk Management - SF GROUP

We are your local knowledge experts in risk management, security, logistics and emergency solution support, defined by the highest regulatory and international standards and applied in any cross-cultural environment

Discretion | Fortitude | Bridging Cultures

International Capability, Local Expertise

In everything we do, SF Group seeks to bridge gaps in an increasingly complex and polarised world. We facilitate safe and sustainable business operations that benefit our clients and the regions in which we operate.

We provide tailored risk management, security, logistics and agency services to internationally recognisable names in commerce, industry and government. We deliver these services in compliance with industry best practice, in places as diverse as the Amazon Basin and the Himalayan Highlands. We achieve this through diligent planning and by utilising personnel with local expertise, linguistic abilities and a vested interest in the development of their area of operations to act on behalf of us and our clients.

Our Services

SF Group delivers discreet and innovative solutions which are customised to address the specific needs of our clients.

SECURITY

The modern world faces a broad spectrum of threats to security and stability. Our understanding of risk in complex environments is derived from world-class professional training and extensive experience working in those environments. Click here for more details on our security services.

MARITIME

SF Group provides a comprehensive range of maritime security and anti-piracy services to the shipping and energy industries operating in the Indian Ocean, Gulf of Guinea and South-East Asia. Click here for more details on our maritime services.

CONSULTANCY

We offer consultancy services and training packages designed to support and equip organisations with the skills needed to operate safely, securely, and sustainably. Click here for more details on our training and consultancy services.

SF BREATHE

Tailored intelligence, targeted analysis. We provide informed and timely notifications of security incidents to help our clients avoid danger and mitigate risks to personnel, assets and reputation. Click here for more details on SF BREATHE.

TRAINING

Empowering individuals and teams with practical skills and knowledge to navigate complex environments safely, securely, and effectively.

TANDAO CYBER

Delivering innovative cybersecurity solutions to safeguard organisations against evolving threats and ensure resilience in a dynamic digital landscape.

Introducing Shane Wall, Maritime Analyst

Introducing Shane Wall: Regional Insight, Practical Experience and a Healthy Sense of Humour Salama Fikira is pleased to introduce Shane Wall, an intelligence and regional affairs professional who has spent more than 25 years living and working in Vietnam. Based in Ho Chi Minh City, Shane brings an unusual combination of military intelligence experience, commercial understanding, language capability and first-hand knowledge of Southeast Asia. He also brings an irreverent and distinctly Australian sense of humour, which helps keep even serious conversations grounded and refreshingly direct. Shane grew up in Australia’s Mallee region and, in his own telling, ran away to sea at 16 to avoid following his father into hard-scrabble farming. He went on to serve for 21 years in the Royal Australian Navy, including more than a decade in military intelligence and analysis. His principal areas of focus were Southeast Asia and the Western Pacific, giving him a strong grounding in the political, security and strategic forces shaping the region. In 2000, Shane relocated to Vietnam and established a language-services business supporting multinational companies and the diplomatic community. Over the years, he has also worked as a Vietnamese-to-English translator, an English-language teacher and Director of Languages and Content for a software and website development company. Most recently, he served as the Vietnam representative of a regional corporate intelligence firm, helping organisations understand the realities of operating in the country and make decisions based on credible local insight rather than assumptions. Shane’s value lies not only in his professional background, but in the depth of his connection to Vietnam. He understands how the country works at both an institutional and personal level, and he has developed the relationships, cultural awareness and judgement that only come from decades on the ground. Away from work, Shane has played Australian Rules Football for more than 40 years. In 2018, he was Assistant Coach for Skills and Tactics with Vietnam’s national women’s team when it won its inaugural AFL Asia Championship. He also produces ambitious quantities of homemade chilli sauce, creates pastry-based snacks and has acquired enough refrigeration equipment for his children to nickname him “He Who Owns Fridges.” Behind the self-deprecating humour is a highly experienced professional with a sharp analytical mind, strong regional instincts and a genuine affection for the country he now calls home. Shane strengthens Salama Fikira’s ability to provide practical, informed and locally grounded support to clients operating in Vietnam and across Southeast Asia. And as an expression of his humour the related image here is a Perth Class Destroyer on which Shane served when he was still wearing shorts.

Salama Fikira Assists International Multimedia Project Across Nairobi

Nairobi 12 June 2026: In May 2026, Salama Fikira was pleased to support a unique cultural project that brought together art, diplomacy and international development in the heart of Nairobi. Promoted by the Italian Cultural Institute of Nairobi and the Embassy of Italy in Kenya, Jute Portraits was a multimedia light projection project created by acclaimed Italian artist Franz Cerami. Developed in collaboration with the UNIDO ACT Coffee Programme, the project highlighted the people at the centre of Kenya's coffee industry, celebrating the farmers, workers and communities whose efforts sustain one of the country's most important export sectors. Drawing on encounters across Kenya's coffee value chain, Cerami created approximately 300 video portraits that were transformed into animated artworks and projected onto buildings across Nairobi. Through light, movement and storytelling, the project sought to make visible the faces and stories that often remain unseen behind the global coffee trade. Over the nights of 28 and 29 May, the artist and his team moved between locations across the city, projecting large-scale images onto prominent buildings and temporarily transforming familiar urban spaces into striking public artworks. While visually impressive, the project presented a number of practical challenges. Operating late at night, moving specialist equipment between locations and conducting activities in public spaces required a discreet security presence that could support the artists and organisers without detracting from the creative nature of the event. Salama Fikira was engaged to provide low-profile security support throughout the operation. Two of our security consultants accompanied the artist and crew, helping to ensure activities could proceed safely and smoothly while maintaining an unobtrusive presence. Our role focused on situational awareness, reassurance and practical support as the team worked across multiple locations. The project culminated on 2 June at the Residence of the Ambassador of Italy during celebrations marking Italy's National Day. Salama Fikira Chairman Conrad Thorpe attended as an observer and was able to witness first-hand the remarkable impact the installations had on Nairobi's skyline and the conversations they generated around culture, community and international partnership. Assignments such as Jute Portraits demonstrate the value of flexible, sensitive and discreet security support. Alongside our work for diplomatic missions, international organisations and corporate clients across East Africa, Salama Fikira is proud to assist cultural and creative projects that require a professional but low-profile approach to security and risk management. We would like to thank the Italian Cultural Institute of Nairobi, the Embassy of Italy in Kenya and the project team for the opportunity to contribute to such an innovative and memorable event.

Salama Fikira and YAVA Launch Strategic Partnership to Deliver Integrated Infrastructure Resilience and Security Solutions Across Complex Markets

London, United Kingdom – 16 May 2026 — Salama Fikira Group today announced a strategic partnership with YAVA, the London-based infrastructure resilience and operational intelligence company, to jointly deliver integrated cyber, infrastructure, operational security, and deployment capabilities across high-risk and rapidly evolving global markets. The partnership reflects growing international demand for resilience solutions that combine physical security, operational continuity, cyber capability, logistics support, and infrastructure intelligence into a unified delivery model. The collaboration was highlighted in YAVA’s April 2026 Monthly Report, which examined the increasing convergence of infrastructure security, operational resilience, and risk intelligence. Under the agreement, Salama Fikira will introduce YAVA’s cyber, systems audit, operational intelligence, and infrastructure assessment capabilities into client environments requiring advanced technical resilience solutions. In parallel, YAVA will support the introduction of Salama Fikira’s operational security, logistics, transport, and field deployment capabilities into markets where clients require trusted on-the-ground operational support. The partnership is designed to strengthen client outcomes across sectors including critical infrastructure, energy, logistics, aviation, technology infrastructure, and complex operating environments where digital and physical resilience increasingly overlap. “Today’s infrastructure threats are interconnected,” said Bruce Lyman CEO of Salama Fikira Group. “Clients are no longer looking for isolated security or technology solutions. They require integrated operational capability that combines intelligence, cyber resilience, logistics, infrastructure understanding, and execution in the field. Our partnership with YAVA creates exactly that capability and positions both organisations to support clients operating in some of the world’s most demanding environments.” The strategic alliance will focus on: Operational security and protective services Cyber and systems audits Infrastructure resilience assessments Logistics and transport support Technical deployments in higher-risk regions Multi-region operational support for shared clients According to YAVA infrastructure risk is becoming increasingly operational, with resilience depending on coordinated systems capable of functioning under pressure rather than standalone advisory frameworks alone.  Organisations increasingly require trusted partnerships able to assess risk, mobilise capability rapidly, and support implementation directly on the ground. YAVA founder Harry Geisler said: “Resilience is no longer delivered through siloed services. Organisations increasingly need coordinated partners who can combine operational intelligence, infrastructure understanding, technical capability, and deployment execution into one trusted delivery framework. Our partnership with Salama Fikira significantly strengthens our ability to support clients operating across complex and high-pressure environments.” The partnership also creates long-term commercial alignment between the firms, enabling both companies to participate in the long-term value and continuity of client relationships while supporting scalable delivery across expanding international markets. Salama Fikira brings extensive operational experience across Africa and other operating regions, including maritime security, infrastructure support, logistics, government engagement, and operational deployment capabilities. YAVA contributes expertise in infrastructure resilience, cyber risk intelligence, systems auditing, engineering integration, and operational technology support. Both companies believe the partnership reflects a broader shift in global infrastructure markets, where resilience, continuity, and operational visibility are increasingly becoming strategic and commercial priorities rather than purely security considerations. About Salama Fikira Group Salama Fikira Group provides integrated security, operational support, logistics, infrastructure resilience, and risk management solutions across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Middle East. The company supports government, energy, maritime, infrastructure, and commercial clients operating in complex and high-risk environments. About YAVA YAVA is a London-based infrastructure resilience and operational intelligence company focused on cyber capability, infrastructure visibility, operational resilience, and integrated deployment solutions across critical infrastructure and complex operating environments.
